guards: Exact unchanged selected source record/sense/frame/profile/context/aspect only; no old held frame is reopened by root spelling alone.
Four linked cases must retain both exact raw identities, selected target sense, target POS and source links. OVILLAR resolves a noun argument, not a verb synonym.
Keep original form normalizer and source-explicit person/tense/number/subject guards. No suffix inference, accent folding, SE stripping, clitics or new human role for it-only.
Preserve source regional/register labels and explicitly selected sense context. Do not transfer inline alternative geographic meanings into selected CHISCAR fire-making sense.
Closed AGID slots only, including exclusion of malformed/annotated spelling variants; no qualified-head global overrides.
The 405 form senses and 274 candidate spellings are proposal evidence, not measured newly covered translations.
No examples, actual people, hidden game data, source-provided English claims or native/Mexican certification.
